detect_default_device: detect the default PyTorch device from environment variables like FAIRSEQ2_DEVICE or LOCAL_RANK
set_device_context_manager: use set_device as a context manager to scope tensor creation to a specific CUDA device
get_current_device: get the current PyTorch device of the calling thread via get_current_device
supports_device_transfer: implement the SupportsDeviceTransfer abstract class to enable device transfer for custom objects
cuda_context_memory_stats: use CudaContext to query CUDA device properties and memory statistics for a given device
